{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 missing)
# Since the question is about mean flipper length, we can drop missing values
# as they are negligible (2 out of 344)
filtered_penguins = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print results
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
